title: Allowance for a Late Expedited Decision (Formulary Benefit)
content:
**Allowance.** Under the Formulary Benefit, a late-decision allowance is added to the exigency period when the expedited decision is made after it fell due.

The due date is the date of the latest expedited supporting statement for the drug plus the formulary's expedited decision time. That time is the formulary's expedited decision hours divided by twenty-four, which is **24** hours, or 1 day, on every Northbridge formulary. The days late are the days from that statement date to the decision date, less that 1 day.

| Days late | Allowance added |
|---|---|
| at least the late cap of **3** | 3 days (the cap) |
| at least 1 but fewer than 3 | the days late themselves |
| fewer than 1 | nothing |

The allowance is added to the exigency period before the floor of one day is applied.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical expedited statement received 12 July, due 13 July)

| Decision date | Days late | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 13 July | 0 | nothing |
| 14 July | 1 | 1 day |
| 15 July | 2 | 2 days |
| 16 July | 3 | 3 days |
| 20 July | 7 | 3 days (capped) |
